annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires a proxy to discard any received Host header when the request-target is in absolute-form and to set the Host header to the host component (including port if non‑default) of that absolute-form. The wording is clear and consistent with the Host header specification, leaving no materially different implementation options or missing constraints.
